definitions.explanation: An honorific title for a highly skilled and respected painter or artist. Can also be used humorously or sarcastically to describe someone who draws, regardless of skill.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{日本画|にほんが}の{画伯|がはく}だ。
examples.english: He is a master of Japanese-style painting.

examples.japanese: {画伯|がはく}の{作品|さくひん}が{美術館|びじゅつかん}に{展示|てんじ}されている。
examples.english: The master painter's works are on display at the museum.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{描|か}いた{絵|え}を{見|み}て、「さすが{画伯|がはく}」と{冗談|じょうだん}を{言|い}った。
examples.english: Looking at the child's drawing, I jokingly said, 'What a master painter!'

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a respectful title for accomplished painters. In modern usage, it is also used humorously or affectionately, especially online, to refer to anyone who draws — sometimes ironically when the drawing is not particularly skilled.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画伯|がはく}の{作品|さくひん} (the master's works)
- {画伯|がはく}と{呼|よ}ばれる (to be called a master painter)
